data.name: Mohaymin
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'h-y-m' meaning to guard or protect. A Mohaymin is a trustworthy and reliable guardian or protector in Islamic society. The Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) used this title for his companions who were in charge of various Islamic affairs.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of protection and guardianship from Allah.

in_arabic.name: محىмин
in_arabic.long_meaning: المحىمن: هو اسم علم عربي يعني الحارس، المأمون، الواجد، الحافظ. ويُعتبر من أسماء الله الحسنى في القرآن الكريم، ويُردده المومنون في الفاتحة. يرمز إلى الحفاظ على الدين والسماع لله، والوقوف معه في كل خطورة. ويُعتبر مناسبًا للأولاد، خاصة أولاد المسلمين الذين يريدون أن يخلو حياتهم من أي عيب أو خطأ.

in_urdu.name: محىمین
in_urdu.long_meaning: مَحىَمِين: یہ ایک اسلامی نام ہے جس کے معنی حارس، مامون، واضع، حافظ کے ہیں۔ اس نام کو صرف عرب ممالک میں استعمال کیا جاتا ہے اور یہ نام کبھی براہ راست اردو میں ترجمہ ہوا ہی نہیں۔

in_hindi.name: मुहयमीन
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुहयमीन: यह एक मुस्लिम नाम है जिसका अर्थ है रक्षक, विश्वासी, खोजी, संरक्षक। इस नाम का उपयोग भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में किया जाता है। यह नाम पवित्र कुरान में भी उल्लिखित है।

in_pashto.name: محىمین
in_pashto.long_meaning: محىمین: دا يو اسلامي نام دی چې د حارس، مامون، واضع، حافظ معانی لري. دا نام د پښتنو مسلمانو لخوا استعمال کېږي. دا نام په پښتو کي په عربی لیکل کېږي.

in_english.name: Mohaymin
in_english.long_meaning: Mohaymin: This name is derived from Arabic roots and means guardian, trustworthy, finder, protector. In Islamic tradition, it is mentioned in the Quran as one of Allah's beautiful names, and is recited in the Fatiha. It symbolizes the preservation of faith and listening to Allah, and standing with Him in all difficulties. Suitable for boys, especially Muslim boys who want to live a life free from any defect or error.

data.cultural_impact: The title Mohaymin carries a rich cultural significance as it represents a trusted leader, a pillar of strength and stability, and a role model of moral excellence in the Islamic society. Historically, Mohaymins were individuals appointed by the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) or his caliphs to conduct various important affairs, from the collection of zakat (charitable donations), leading military campaigns, to ensuring the preservation and proper execution of Islamic law. By upholding their duties with unwavering commitment, Mohaymins played a vital role in shaping and maintaining the Muslim community's cohesion and integrity.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the term Mohaymin is rooted in its connection to community protection and service. Muslims believe that this noble title represents a strong bond with Allah and a commitment to serve and protect His religion and people. By embodying the qualities of a Mohaymin, such as trustworthiness, integrity, and resilience, one can draw closer to Allah and contribute to the betterment of their community. In essence, the spiritual elevation of a Mohaymin lies in their ability to inspire and guide others towards a path of righteousness, and to offer protection and comfort in times of need.
